thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate and latency on /v2/generate — p95 jumped from ~420ms to ~1.2s, p99 from ~1.8s to ~6.2s, 5xx rate increased to ~6.5% across us-west-2. Triggered at 2026-03-15T09:12:30Z

maria: I got the page, taking it now — oncall. Starting triage.

vikram: thx. any immediate customer reports?

support: got an inbound about multiple customers seeing "Request timed out" errors in last 10m. Ticket attached: https://support.internal/t/INC-7832

alex: looking at graphs — spike lines up exactly with deploy at 09:11:58 UTC. routing-service v3.2.0 roll started then.

deploy-bot: deploy: routing-service v3.2.0 -> started at 2026-03-15T09:11:58Z by jen. Canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

maria: copying logs from ingress:
```
[09:12:20] upstream request timeout to 10.0.42.78:5000 path=/v2/generate status=504 latency=5005ms
[09:12:21] backend error 500 llm-infer-2 shard=7 kv-cache miss
[09:12:25] keepalive reset from client id=xxx
```

sam: sounds like routing-service change impacted connection pooling/keepalive. p95 blowup suggests head-of-line or multiplex regression.

maria: can someone run a quick healthcheck on the old revision and see if rollback fixes? If yes, we should revert to v3.1.7.

alex: running `kubectl rollout status deploy/routing-service -n prod` now, and fetching previous revision: `kubectl rollout history deploy/routing-service -n prod`

alex: previous revision is v3.1.7. I can trigger `kubectl rollout undo` if we want immediate revert.

maria: do it. prioritize latency reduction over any small feature.

jen: initiating rollback now.

jen: command: 
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/routing-service --to-revision=3
```
deploy-bot: rollback: routing-service -> rolling back to revision 3 (v3.1.7). Started at 2026-03-15T09:14:05Z.

maria: switching traffic off canary -> routing table confirm? alex can you watch envoy stats and connpool?

alex: watching envoy — active connections dropping on new pods, new pods draining. connpool_timeout errors falling in logs.

incident-bot: Metrics update (09:17 UTC): p95 1.2s -> 480ms, p99 6.2s -> 1.9s, 5xx rate 6.5% -> 0.6% :thumbsup:

support: customer ticket updated with mitigation note. Notifying affected accounts list to CS: @support-team.

vikram: excellent. Maria — can you estimate customer-impacted request volume in the 09:11–09:17 window? We need an initial SLO impact statement.

maria: querying logs — approx 42k requests in that 6m window, error ~6.5% => ~2730 failed requests. Most failures were timeouts (504) rather than 500.

sam: add runbook entry: possible regression when changing keepalive defaults in routing-service. We'll add to postmortem.

jen: post-rollback smoke looks good. Latency stable, error rate back to baseline.

maria: switching pager to handoff mode — tagging next responder. I will remain as incident lead for postmortem.

alex: leave a timeline note:
- 09:11:58 deploy routing-service v3.2.0
- 09:12:30 incident alert (p99 elevated)
- 09:13:00 oncall paged (maria)
- 09:14:05 rollback to v3.1.7 started
- 09:17:00 metrics back towards baseline

support: flagging top 10 affected customers to CS for outreach: list saved at https://docs.internal/incidents/INC-7832/customers.csv

vikram: good work. We should create an incident ticket and assign owners for follow-ups: root cause, test coverage for keepalive/connpool, deploy gating.

maria: created INCIDENT-2026-03-15-01 in our tracker with initial notes and assigned sam (root-cause), jen (deploy fixes), alex (monitoring alerts). Link: https://incidents.internal/INCIDENT-2026-03-15-01

sam: immediate action items I'm picking up:
- reproduce failure locally with routing-service v3.2.0 and cao load test
- audit connection pool + keepalive flag changes in PR #4521
- add integration test to catch p95 regressions on canary

jen: I'll prepare a patched release (v3.2.1) with keepalive revert and small concurrency guard, will run limited canary next time.

maria: for the customer note: we'll send a short message about brief elevated timeouts between 09:12–09:17 UTC, services recovered after rollback. CC product for external comms.

support: drafted message and waiting for PR to comms: "We observed elevated timeouts affecting API calls to /v2/generate between 09:12–09:17 UTC. The issue was caused by a recent deploy and was mitigated by a rollback. We're investigating and will follow up with a timeline."

vikram: handoff complete. Maria, keep incident open until postmortem doc lands and owners confirm mitigations.

maria: ack. closing pager call but keeping incident ticket open for RCA. :white_check_mark:
